newsitem.title: USA: South Jersey to sell Morie sand mining unit.
newsitem.headline: South Jersey to sell Morie sand mining unit.

text.p: South Jersey Industries Inc said Wednesday that it agreed to sell Morie Co, its sand mining and distribution operation, for about $55 million in cash.

The sale to Unimin Corp, the world's largest producer of silica sand, is expected to close in early December. Unimin, a privately held company based in New Canaan, Connecticut, supplies to the semiconductor, glass, ceramic and other industries.

South Jersey Industries is a diversified holding company with investments in natural gas distribution and marketing, natural resources development, utility construction, general contracting and environmental remediation and consulting.
